title: Swimmer drowning Ballybunion Ladies Beach
description: Swimmer caught in rip at south end of Ladies Beach. Full moon spring tide, W wind 20kts gusting 30kts, sig wave height 2.5m. RNLI Ballybunion launched but casualty recovered on beach.

title: Multiple swimmers rescued Ballybunion Caves
description: Five swimmers rescued after being cut off by rapidly rising tide at the Caves. Spring tide (>4.5m range). WSW 18kts wind. RNLI Kilrush + coast guard responded.

title: Bodyboarder unable to return to shore Ballybunion
description: Bodyboarder unable to return to shore against SW wind and rip. Helped by lifeguard. Wind 17kts SW, wave 1.6m, neap tide.

title: Brother and sister drown in rip current at Ballybunion Men's Beach
description: Desmond Byrne (51) from Roscommon and his sister Muriel Eriksson (62) from Sweden drowned while swimming at the Men's Beach. Inquest heard there was a severe rip current 'very bad all summer' in the middle section between the beaches. Lifeguards had been keeping crowds back from that area. Kilrush RNLI lifeboat, Fenit inshore lifeboat, Coast Guard helicopter Rescue 115 and Community Air Ambulance responded. Inquest verdict: death by misadventure.
